title: Cross-surface replication of composition findings and the controls owed
description: These claims name the replications and controls the archive's composition findings still require: repeated runs across times, places and surfaces, A/B entry materials, and comparison of composition layers such as Bing Copilot and Google AI Mode under the single-owner discount. They come from the TL;DR traversal logs, the Sigil installation log, the single-owner discount paper, the godkinggoogle critique, the Revelation First work plan, the Recoding of a Distinction and the Semantic Economy Valuation 001. Nearly all are unbuilt tests.

claims.statement: **Planned controls for future replication:** A/B entry materials (Logotic Programming versus neutral specification); repeated runs at different times; blind coding of mode from output transcripts; ablation of symbolic vocabulary while preserving conceptual structure.

claims.registered_title: The Single-Owner Discount: Provenance Concentration and Epistemic Class Reproduction in Generative Search
claims.statement: The comparison case is the differential between generative search systems with different composition thresholds. Bing's Copilot and Google's AI Mode evaluating the same query against the same indexed material should, on this hypothesis, produce systematically different composition rates for the same single-owner support clusters. Cross-system differential is a measurable signal.
